title: Scheduled input law (--tap x,y[@frame])
statement: Legacy form (--tap x,y): tap k fires at frame k (byte-identical to stored W4 evidence). Extension (S73): --tap x,y@frame fires the tap AFTER frame k renders (real user cadence between frames). All-or-none CLI validation; recorded fields: target coordinate, target View, frame, event, resulting state change.
test: legacy byte-identical vs stored W4 frames; snake 23 scheduled taps autonomous session
